sourceText.he: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: אִם שָׁהָה [כְּדֵי בִיקּוּר]. מַאי כְּדֵי בִיקּוּר? אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כְּדֵי בִּיקֻּרוֹ שֶׁל חָכָם. אִם כֵּן, נָתַתָּ דְּבָרֶיךָ לְשִׁיעוּרִין! אֶלָּא, כְּדֵי בִּיקּוּר טַבָּח חָכָם.

positions.claim: a slaughter interrupted for the duration of an examination is invalid
the measure is the time a Sage takes to examine the knife
the measure is the time a slaughterer who is himself a Sage takes to examine his knife, so that no travel time enters the shiur
positions.basis: the objection that a shiur may not vary with circumstance
